name: Sentinel
summary: Twin left-arm burst lasers support a torso plasma rifle and secondary emitters. Compound cooling keeps the compact fighter firing through close exchanges.
lore: The Sentinel is the Continuance's answer to a crowded loading yard: compact armour, a plasma projector protected in the torso and burst emitters where an older refit carried a cannon. Certified compound exchangers make the restored battery practical. The unused right-arm ballistic interface remains compatible with local guns; a commander can fit one, but the standard machine now carries Aurelian emitters throughout. Crews call it a line fighter. Depot officers insist on calling it a custody instrument.
strengths: Accurate burst fire and target-heating plasma
Compound cooling with no weapon ammunition
weaknesses: Left arm and right torso carry the main weapons
